summary: Three-year pause: the Arizona Commerce Authority may not accept applications for, or grant tax relief to, any new computer data center from July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2029. Existing certificates unaffected, and the provision self-repeals July 1, 2029. The Governor's office estimates about $57M in savings over the window (an administration estimate, not a formal fiscal note). ACA received 113 applications in the final two weeks before the window closed
source_name: Arizona Legislature, SB 1861/HB 4168 as-enacted fact sheet
